items.title: UC Merced Pilots Summer Investment Academy to Help Students Build Skills, Connections
items.summary: By Brenda Ortiz, UC Merced October 8, 2026 Twenty-six first-year students participated in UC Merced's first Summer Investment Academy on campus. items.title: $4.5 million NIH Grant Expands Interdisciplinary Biomedical Training at UC Merced
items.summary: By Patty Guerra, UC Merced October 7, 2026 The funding supports up to 16 graduate students for two years.
